posts.trend: Baby Care Quick-Commerce Startup Kiddo, Raises Pre-seed Round of 12.5 Cr Led by Campus Fund
posts.context: New urban parents rely heavily on quick commerce because they have no extended family support nearby in the metro city.
posts.angle: Having a child converts emergency parenting into an expensive series of 10-minute delivery notifications.
slides: A newborn converts your phone into a life-support system.

posts.caption: The village it takes to raise a child has been replaced by a 10-minute delivery app. 🍼 #parenting #quickcommerce #startup
posts.rank_verdict: An incredibly sharp observation of quick-commerce dependency that will immediately find its way into parental WhatsApp groups.
